QuestInfo.name: Gold Richie's Secret Weapon Test
QuestInfo.0: Gold Richie asks that you come see him, because he has something amazing to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie's secret weapon is finally complete. However, he lost the Ignition Key. It's probably somewhere close, so defeat the monsters nearby to find it. Once you have it, test out the secret weapon, then report back to Gold Richie.
QuestInfo.2: You reported to Gold Richie that you found the Ignition Key and tested the secret weapon, which ended up exploding.

0.0: Finally, Gold Richie's secret weapon is complete! Wanna see?

yes.0: Gaga has been developing a secret weapon for me. After all sorts of struggles, it's finally finished. With the new weapon, we should be able to drive the Black Wings out of Edelstein in no time! Yes! Hahahahaha!
yes.1: I'll let you test this secret weapon. Normally, I would do it myself, but I have a lot of business to take care of. I swear! It's not because I think it'll be dangerous or anything... Honest.
yes.2: There is a problem, though. I lost the Ignition Key while I was out walking. And, you can't activate the secret weapon without the Ignition Key...
yes.3: I hadn't gone too far from here when I lost the Ignition Key, so you should be able to find it somewhere nearby. After you find the Ignition Key, execute the Secret Weapon Test immediately. I left the secret weapon next to Gaga.

no.0: You're not interested? But, this is Gold Richie's secret weapon!

1.0: So? How did the test go? My secret weapon was amazing, huh? Hey...what's with the long face?

yes.0: What? It failed? Hmm...strange. I thought the secret weapon would easily drive the Black Wings out of Edelstein.

npc.0: Hurry up and obtain the Ignition Key! We must test the Secret Weapon!
